quotes.text: Mike O. Amazing guide service, incredible fishing and beautiful area to fish! I had some time become available last minute and Clint was very helpful in helping me arrange my first fishing visit to BC. He worked very hard to put me on some great fish despite some weather challenges. This included coaching me through landing my personal best fish on the fly which was a battle I will never forget. I look forward to going back in the near future. Great outfit and I'd recommend a trip to any level of angler. - 10/14/2019

Leon Z. Their is not much I can say but Wow, what a great experience. We did a full day in August during the Pink run and it was amazing. It starts with the quality of guides, we had two for the three of us, with two being novices. Then came the equipment, all top notch. And finally, they took us all form not knowing what to do to all landing fish in the first 30 minutes. I doubt you will find a better guiding experience if you want to perfect your craft of catch your first fish. Well done! - 9/03/2019

stacie g. I truly enjoyed my trip with Valley Fishing Guides. Ryan was my guide, he was perfectly prescriptive and a wonderful, knowledgeable guide. I am newer to fly fishing and he gave me even more motivation to keep up the sport. I will 100% be back! I would not have change one thing about the trip, it was perfect. - 7/25/2019

Great Day of fishing in not the best conditions. I know the time of year I was up there was not the best fishing. Clint took me out and instead of just getting me some fish he taught me skills of nymphing that I can use better for years to come. I went fishing in September and have been on a few trips on my own and know I have hooked several more fish than I would have indicator fishing with a float. So thank you Clint for putting me on several fish as well as having a impact on the rest of my fishing trips to come! If you want to truly learn, Clint is the Man! More - 10/26/2018
